rows.text: Due to his bizarre aesthetics of destruction, Asat Pramad has garnered quite a following in the cosmos. After an acceptable amount of staff casualties, the nosy daredevils from Interastral Peace Entertainment managed to snap photos of this Lord Ravager and produced a set of fan merchandise based on his image. However, due to some as-yet-unknown principle, this die always lands on the same number. The Intelligentsia Guild speculates that this is because randomness, or chaos, is an essential component of Elation. "If a die knew its result before being cast, wouldn't that take all the fun out of it?"
